scenarios.name: Hero Air Force 1 '07 Stockout Shock
scenarios.description: Top-selling hero shoe (Nike Air Force 1 '07, 65% gross margin) runs out of warehouse inventory. Ad spend keeps driving traffic to an empty product page.
scenarios.autonomousResponse: Stockout Kill-Switch activates in <15 mins. Spend throttled -,200/day and diverted to Google Shopping React Infinity Flyknit (+3.6x ROAS).

scenarios.name: Meta Footwear Auction CPM Surge (+45%)
scenarios.description: Holiday sneaker flash sales drive Meta Advantage+ CPM from .50 to 4.20, compressing ROAS below the 1.8x break-even floor.
scenarios.autonomousResponse: ROAS drops below break-even. Engine pulls ,500/day from Meta and redistributes to Amazon Sponsored Products & Google PMax.

scenarios.name: Meta Reels Air Max 270 Creative Fatigue (-60% CTR)
scenarios.description: Hero sneaker UGC video frequency exceeds 5.2. Hook rate collapses, CTR drops 60%, and customer acquisition cost (CAC) doubles.
scenarios.injectedEvent: Creative fatigue wear-out on Meta Reels creative batch #4
scenarios.autonomousResponse: Auto-pauses exhausted ad set, triggers creative refresh alert to Nike design studio, and reroutes spend to high-vitality Advantage+ Catalog.

scenarios.name: Amazon Buy Box Sneaker Price Undercut
scenarios.description: Rival footwear seller launches aggressive 25% price drop on Amazon, lowering Nike Zoom Fly conversion rate from 4.8% to 2.8%.
scenarios.autonomousResponse: Optimizer re-solves scipy convex problem: shifts capital to Nike Direct Brand Search where gross margins are preserved at 68%.
